contexts.text: Before regeneration, cupidities and Falsities... continually predominate.
While truth still predominates... When good has the predominance... Representation. AC 6567.
With whom evils have obtained the predominance... Those with whom goods have had the predominance...
For the glory of self predominates...
The sole difficulty is... to prevent the love of self and of the world from predominating.

With the man the understanding predominates; and with the woman the will predominates; and the man is according to that which predominates. But in the marriages in the Heavens there is no predominance. Explained.
The application of the male is to... the things in which the understanding predominates.
The faith which, from its predominance, is called saving.
With these, there predominates the love of self and of the world...
There must be a predominance of loves, of the one over the ether...
These delights, when they predominate, cause the man not to believe...
